# NEW 2026-11-22 v10.0 Worker 1 (Slot 75): Playable Golden Horde & Timurids (oe_pglh_). Generated by gen_playable_glh.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Country scope. True for playable Golden Horde / Timurid / successor steppe hosts.
oe_pglh_is_host = {
	is_rebel_country = no
	OR = {
		tag = GLH
		tag = TIM
		tag = CRI
		tag = ATR
		has_variable = oe_pglh_adopted_host
	}
}

# Country scope. Owns at least one historical sedentary steppe capital anchor.
oe_pglh_controls_sedentary_anchor = {
	OR = {
		owns = location:sarai_al_jadid
		owns = location:astrakhan
		owns = location:samarkand
	}
}

# Country scope. Eligible to proclaim the New Yassa Charter and transition from army horde to landed monarchy.
oe_pglh_can_settle_horde = {
	oe_pglh_is_host = yes
	oe_pglh_controls_sedentary_anchor = yes
	OR = {
		country_type = army
		government_type = government_type:steppe_horde
	}
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = oe_pglh_sedentary }
		var:oe_pglh_sedentary >= 75
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Country scope. Owns both Volga-Don canal gateway anchors (Astrakhan and Tana).
oe_pglh_has_volga_canal_anchors = {
	owns = location:astrakhan
	owns = location:tana
}

# Any scope. Read-only check against Slot 45 oe_ghh_cohesion (null-safe).
oe_pglh_ghh_cohesion_strong = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ghh_cohesion }
		global_var:oe_ghh_cohesion >= 60
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Any scope. Read-only check against Slot 45 oe_ghh_phase during Great Troubles (2..3).
oe_pglh_ghh_in_troubles = {
	trigger_if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable = oe_ghh_phase }
		global_var:oe_ghh_phase >= 2
		global_var:oe_ghh_phase <= 3
	}
	trigger_else = { always = no }
}

# Country scope. True if bordering or at war with a major Eurasian rival (RUS/MOS/PLC/POL/BYZ/TUR/IRA).
oe_pglh_has_great_rival = {
	OR = {
		AND = { country_exists = c:RUS NOT = { tag = RUS } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:RUS is_at_war_with = c:RUS } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:MOS NOT = { tag = MOS } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:MOS is_at_war_with = c:MOS } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:PLC NOT = { tag = PLC } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:PLC is_at_war_with = c:PLC } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:POL NOT = { tag = POL } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:POL is_at_war_with = c:POL } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ NOT = { tag = BYZ } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:BYZ is_at_war_with = c:BYZ } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:TUR NOT = { tag = TUR } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:TUR is_at_war_with = c:TUR } }
		AND = { country_exists = c:IRA NOT = { tag = IRA } OR = { is_neighbor_of = c:IRA is_at_war_with = c:IRA } }
	}
}
